paper_title: APT Improving Specialist LLM Performance with Weakness Case Acquisition   and Iterative Preference Training
caption: The exploration of hyperparameters.
model_annotation: This line plot illustrates the variation of a metric labeled "Dolly" across a range of values for the hyperparameter 'α', which is plotted on the x-axis. The x-axis is linear, spans from 0 to 4, and is marked with tick labels at integer intervals. The y-axis is also linear, ranging from approximately 22.75 to 23.75, with major grid lines and tick labels at 0.25 intervals. A single teal line, marked with teal circular data points, represents the "Dolly" metric. The line begins at an x-value of 0 with a y-value of approximately 22.75, rises sharply to a peak at an x-value of approximately 0.5 with a y-value of 23.75, then decreases steadily to an x-value of 4 with a y-value of approximately 22.75.
